'If Battering Bolt hits a hero' = TRIGGERED ON_HIT + ATTACK_TARGET_IS_HERO (condition_types.py:1932-1949): false when the attack was declared at a permanent or ally, true for a hero.

Discard half: DISCARD reads player/amount and builds its predicate through _hand_card_filter (effect_types.py:446-509), whose 'filter' key takes ordinary DSL condition specs evaluated with the CANDIDATE hand card as the card argument. NOT(inner_type CARD_IS_TYPE, card_type 'Action') keeps exactly the non-action cards - CARD_IS_TYPE matches types AND subtypes and 'Action' is a type (condition_types.py:1281-1297), so release note 2 ('Action cards are not discarded. All other card types are discarded including Attack Reactions, Defense Reactions, Instants, Mentors etc.') falls out: every non-Action card fails the inner test and passes the NOT. amount 'ALL' is spelled out in the handler (effect_types.py:1217) as the whole hand's count; effect_discard offers only matching cards and stops when none remain (ability_keywords.py:1538-1573), so action cards survive and everything else goes - the discarding player chooses the order among them, which cannot matter here since all matching cards are taken.

Life half: DISCARD stores what it ACTUALLY discarded under the 'discarded' ref (effect_types.py:1230-1233), single card unwrapped or a list; LOSE_LIFE resolves its dict amount via _resolve_amount (effect_types.py:1121-1122) and COUNT_REF counts that ref (effect_types.py:139-177), handling both shapes. Because the filter already excluded actions, everything in the ref IS 'each card discarded this way', so no negative filter is needed on the count (COUNT_REF has no negated type filter). Empty hand or all-action hand discards nothing, the ref is never set, COUNT_REF returns 0, and no life is lost - matching 'then they lose 1{h} for each card discarded this way'.

Reveal half ('they reveal their hand'): modelled as LOOK_AT HAND / OPPONENT / ALL (handler at effect_types.py:3292-3351 fully supports this zone/player/amount), which exposes the entire hand into the ability's reference scope but does NOT set is_public - it is a LOOK, not a true CR reveal. No plain reveal-hand primitive exists: REVEAL_HAND_MARK_IF_TYPE couples the reveal to a mark side-effect this card must not have, and REVEAL_TOP_DECK is the wrong zone. The residual difference is information-only - every non-action card is immediately discarded face-up regardless - so no decision depends on the reveal; flagged rather than hacked around.
